mapper.select: SELECT ID, AMOUNT, CATEGORY, STATUS, CREATED FROM OA_EXPENSE WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY CREATED DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO OA_EXPENSE (ID, USER_ID, DEPT_ID, AMOUNT, CATEGORY, STATUS, CREATED) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{deptId}, #{amount}, #{category}, 'SUBMITTED', SYSDATE)
mapper.update: UPDATE OA_EXPENSE SET STATUS = 'AUDITED', AUDITOR = #{auditor}, AUDITED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE ID = #{id} AND STATUS = 'SUBMITTED'
UPDATE OA_EXPENSE SET STATUS = 'REJECTED', AUDITOR = #{auditor} WHERE ID = #{id} AND STATUS = 'SUBMITTED'
UPDATE OA_EXPENSE SET STATUS = 'PAID', CASHIER = #{cashier}, PAID_AT = SYSDATE WHERE ID = #{id} AND STATUS = 'AUDITED'
